title: CIDG seizes P2.42M worth of illegal ‘ukay-ukay’ in Bacolod City

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) operatives arrested a 39-year-old man and seized 60 bales of undocumented imported used clothing, locally known as “ukay-ukay,” valued at P2.42 million, during a joint law enforcement operation in Barangay Cabug here on Monday afternoon, Nov. 16. Operatives from the CIDG Regional Field Unit–Negros Island Region, together with the CIDG Bacolod City Field Unit, the Provincial Intelligence Unit of the Negros Occidental Police Provincial Office, and Bacolod City Police Station 9, carried out the operation.
